title: And ever shall be, world without end.
html_source:
This refers to the Gloria Patri:

Glory be to the Father, and to the Son :
and to the Holy Ghost;
As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be :
world without end. Amen.

PROPOSED SUGGESTION: This can be read as a death-urge that minimizes the effect of the individual, as a secular modification of the “Glory be,” as a wish to be free of the ghost of his mother, or as a rational conclusion that the world did not and could not have disappeared because he shut his eyes for a short period of time.
